notPartOfPreregistration: Written after the sealed verdict. Reports no verdict, moves no threshold, and does not alter glp1r-d153-functional-model.sealed.json.

trainMeanBaseline.predictor: constant = mean pActivity of the training split
trainMeanBaseline.reading: The sealed model has to beat this to mean anything. It does, by a wide margin, so the pass is not an artefact of a narrow activity range.

nearestNeighbourTanimoto.direction: each test row to its closest training row
nearestNeighbourTanimoto.fingerprint: the same Morgan r=2 512-bit folded fingerprint the model is fitted on
nearestNeighbourTanimoto.reading: This is the load-bearing caveat. The split is scaffold-disjoint and compound-disjoint, which is what the frozen gate asks for and what it got. It is NOT chemically distant: the median test row has a close training analogue, and a minority sit at or above 0.90. So the sealed result says the model interpolates within this chemical series. It does not say the model extrapolates to a new series, and nothing here licenses that claim.
